current_2026_transition.federal_change: FTA withdrew Circular 4704.1A guidance. FTA states the withdrawal eliminates the Circular-based EEO program plan/document submission and FTA review/oversight burden while leaving underlying federal nondiscrimination obligations intact.
current_2026_transition.kentucky_state_context: KYTC's current Transportation Delivery resources page continues to state that Kentucky and its transit agencies must comply with EEO and maintain nondiscrimination/affirmative-action/policy-posting practices. The latest located FTA-approved Kentucky State Management Plan (approved 2024, modified 2024) still contains pre-withdrawal Circular 4704.1A EEO Program threshold/submission language.
current_2026_transition.current_interpretation: Do not assume a recurring federal Circular 4704.1A EEO Program submission is currently required after 2026-06-05. Also do not assume Kentucky has abandoned all pass-through EEO documentation requirements: the current public state resources have not yet been found to reconcile the federal withdrawal with the older State Management Plan. Current KYTC/OTD instructions should be obtained before any new plan submission.
current_2026_transition.current_internal_rtec_policy: RTEC has a signed current EEO policy/program statement dated 2026-08-26. That is current internal EEO policy evidence, but it is not automatically equivalent to a historical full utilization/goals/timetables program package.
